Extinguish the Fire Golems hiding in [[the Undercity]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Destroy the [[Fire Golem|fire golems]]. You have [5...0] fire golems remaining.
* See the [[Emperor's Hand]] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Imperial Commendation]]

== Walkthrough ==
Exit from [[Nahpui Quarter (outpost)|Nahpui Quarter]] into [[Wajjun Bazaar]] and head to the Undercity [[portal]], killing any Am Fah groups you happen to run into. (This is a lot quicker if you have [[Seek out Brother Tosai]] active, since there are no foes in Wajjun Bazaar.)

Simply head southeast once inside the Undercity and kill the Fire Golems.

You must descend to the depths of the '''Undercity''' and destroy this fiery abomination! Once you have done so, notify the '''Emperor's Hand''' of your victory. You must not fail!"''

=== Reward dialogue ===
;Emperor's Hand
: ''"A creature from the [[Ring of Fire Islands|Fire Island Chain]]? More than one of them you say? The emperor is in your debt, <Character name>. I shall see that he is made aware of your deeds."''

== Notes ==
* The so-called "fire" golems are the same as [[Flesh Golem (NPC)|Flesh Golem]]s from the [[Ring of Fire Islands]].
